recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It completes the remaining FHIR-43353-facing summary cleanup without reopening later component-binding decisions or broadening into unrelated Vital Signs profile summary modernization.
issue_request: FHIR-43353 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked to remove an overly restrictive required Vital Signs unit binding from component values; the final resolution also called for preferred UCUM bindings on Observation.valueQuantity and component.valueQuantity.
initial_application: Git 5fb05686fb applied the formal profile change by adding a preferred ucum-vitals-common binding for Observation.valueQuantity and relaxing component.valueQuantity from required to preferred. Later FHIR-47136/FHIR-44721 work moved the component valueQuantity binding to the all-UCUM value set http://unitsofmeasure.org/vs.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and the Observation Vital Signs IG includes StructureDefinition/vitalsigns, so the edited XML is in build scope. FHIR-44721 is already represented on the combined branch and confirms the current all-UCUM component binding should be preserved. FHIR-49736 previously removed unrelated stale component mandatory summary text from the same profile.
reconciliation: Updated the structuredefinition-summary and profile-summary extensions in source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml to say UCUM units are preferred and Observation.valueQuantity.code has a preferred binding to Vital Signs Units. The formal value[x] and component.value[x]:valueQuantity bindings were already correct and were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml: updated both active summary extensions so Observation.valueQuantity.code is described with a preferred Vital Signs Units binding instead of a required binding/fixed UCUM system.
